points.title: 王室降生
points.description: 1638年9月5日，路易十四出生于法国圣日耳曼昂莱宫，是法国国王路易十三与奥地利的安妮王子的长子。他的出生被视为神迹，因为路易十三此前曾被告知他将没有继承人。这一时期正值法国绝对君主制初期，王室权力正在巩固，而路易十四的出生为这一王朝的未来奠定了基础。
points.descriptionEn: Born on September 5, 1638, at the Château de Saint-Germain-en-Laye, Louis XIV was the eldest son of King Louis XIII and Anne of Austria. His birth was considered a miracle as Louis XIII had been previously told he would have no heir. This period marked the early phase of French absolute monarchy, with royal power being consolidated, and Louis XIV's birth laid the foundation for the future of this dynasty.

points.title: 摄政时期
points.description: 1643年路易十三去世，年仅5岁的路易十四继位，由母亲奥地利的安妮担任摄政，红衣主教马萨林担任首席顾问。这一时期经历了两次投石党运动（1648-1653），严重动摇了王权。年幼的路易十四亲眼目睹了贵族的叛乱和民众的暴动，这些经历深刻影响了他后来的统治理念，使他坚定了加强中央集权、削弱贵族权力的决心。
points.descriptionEn: Following Louis XIII's death in 1643, the 5-year-old Louis XIV ascended the throne with his mother Anne of Austria as regent and Cardinal Mazarin as chief advisor. This period witnessed two Fronde revolts (1648-1653), which severely undermined royal authority. The young Louis witnessed firsthand noble rebellions and popular uprisings, experiences that profoundly influenced his later governance philosophy, strengthening his resolve to centralize power and diminish aristocratic influence.

points.title: 亲政初期
points.description: 1661年马萨林去世，23岁的路易十四开始亲政。他立即处死了财政大臣尼古拉·富凯，展示了王权的绝对权威。在巴黎期间，他推行了一系列改革：整顿财政，由科尔贝推行重商主义政策；改革军队，建立常备军；加强中央集权，削弱地方贵族权力。他还开始扩建凡尔赛宫，将其从狩猎小屋发展为政治中心。这一时期奠定了法国作为欧洲强国的地位，路易十四的个人威望也达到顶峰。
points.descriptionEn: In 1661, following Mazarin's death, the 23-year-old Louis XIV began his personal rule. He immediately had Finance Minister Nicolas Fouquet executed, demonstrating the absolute authority of the crown. During his time in Paris, he implemented a series of reforms: reorganizing finances with Jean-Baptiste Colbert's mercantilist policies; reforming the army by establishing a standing army; and centralizing power while diminishing local noble authority. He also began expanding the Palace of Versailles, transforming it from a hunting lodge into a political center. This period established France as a European power and brought Louis XIV's personal prestige to its zenith.

points.title: 凡尔赛统治
points.description: 1682年，路易十四正式将宫廷迁至凡尔赛宫，开始了所谓的'凡尔赛统治'。在这里，他通过精心设计的宫廷礼仪和奢华的生活方式，将贵族吸引到凡尔赛，削弱了他们在地方的权力。他继续推行扩张政策，发动了包括大同盟战争在内的多次战争，使法国疆域达到最大。同时，他也是艺术和文化的伟大赞助人，支持拉辛、莫里哀等艺术家，建立了法兰西学术院和法兰西科学院。晚年，他因宗教迫害（如南特敕令的废除）和连年战争而受到批评，但他的绝对君主制理念和对法国中央集权的贡献影响深远。
points.descriptionEn: In 1682, Louis XIV officially moved his court to the Palace of Versailles, beginning what is known as his 'Versailles rule.' Here, through meticulously designed court etiquette and lavish lifestyle, he attracted nobles to Versailles, diminishing their local power. He continued expansionist policies, launching multiple wars including the War of the Grand Alliance, which expanded French territory to its maximum. Simultaneously, he was a great patron of arts and culture, supporting artists like Racine and Molière, and establishing the French Academy and French Academy of Sciences. In his later years, he faced criticism for religious persecutions (such as the revocation of the Edict of Nantes) and continuous wars, but his absolutist principles and contributions to French centralization had far-reaching influence.

points.title: 逝世与遗产
points.description: 1715年9月1日，路易十四在凡尔赛宫逝世，享年77岁，统治长达72年，是欧洲历史上统治时间最长的君主之一。他的临终遗言是'我走了，但国家将永远存在'。路易十四留下了庞大的帝国和绝对君主制的典范，但也留下了巨额债务和连年战争。他的继任者路易十五继承了王位，但法国的黄金时代已接近尾声。路易十四的统治塑造了现代法国，他的中央集权制度、行政改革和文化影响至今仍可见，凡尔赛宫也成为法国君主制辉煌的象征。
points.descriptionEn: On September 1, 1715, Louis XIV died at the Palace of Versailles at the age of 77, having ruled for 72 years, one of the longest reigns in European history. His last words were 'I am going, but the state will remain.' Louis XIV left behind a vast empire and a model of absolute monarchy, but also enormous debts and continuous wars. His successor, Louis XV, inherited the throne, but France's golden age was nearing its end. Louis XIV's reign shaped modern France; his centralized authority, administrative reforms, and cultural influence remain visible today, and the Palace of Versailles stands as a symbol of the splendor of French monarchy.

supporter.zh: 路易十四被视为法国最伟大的君主之一，他建立了强大的中央集权国家，使法国成为欧洲的霸主。他推行的一系列行政、财政和军事改革奠定了现代法国国家的基础。作为艺术的伟大赞助人，他促进了法国文化的繁荣，使法语成为外交和文学的语言。他的统治时期被称为'伟大世纪'，法国的科学、艺术和文学成就达到了顶峰，凡尔赛宫成为欧洲宫廷的典范。
supporter.en: Louis XIV is regarded as one of France's greatest monarchs who established a powerful centralized state, making France a European hegemon. The series of administrative, financial, and military reforms he implemented laid the foundation for the modern French state. As a great patron of the arts, he promoted the flourishing of French culture, making French the language of diplomacy and literature. His reign, known as the 'Grand Siècle,' saw French science, art, and literature reach their zenith, with the Palace of Versailles becoming a model for European courts.

critic.zh: 批评者认为路易十四的绝对君主制导致了法国社会的不平等和僵化。他发动的一系列战争耗尽了国家财政，为后来的法国大革命埋下了伏笔。他废除南特敕令，迫害胡格诺派教徒，损害了法国的经济和声誉。他的奢华生活方式和凡尔赛宫的过度建设加重了民众的负担。此外，他的外交政策虽然扩张了法国领土，但也引起了欧洲其他国家的敌对，形成了长期的联盟对抗法国的局面。
critic.en: Critics argue that Louis XIV's absolutism led to social inequality and rigidity in France. The series of wars he exhausted the national finances, laying the groundwork for the French Revolution. His revocation of the Edict of Nantes and persecution of Huguenots damaged France's economy and reputation. His lavish lifestyle and the excessive construction of Versailles加重了民众的负担. Additionally, his foreign policy, while expanding French territory, provoked hostility from other European powers, leading to long-term alliances against France.

objective.zh: 从历史学角度看，路易十四是一位复杂的君主，既是法国辉煌时代的缔造者，也是后来危机的根源。他建立的绝对君主制模式影响了整个欧洲的政治发展。在流行文化中，他常被描绘为'太阳王'，象征着王权的绝对与辉煌。他的统治代表了旧制度(Ancien Régime)的巅峰，也预示了其不可避免的衰落。历史学家普遍认为，他的统治既有开创性的成就，也有严重的局限性，是理解法国从封建社会向现代国家转变的关键人物。
objective.en: From a historical perspective, Louis XIV was a complex monarch who was both the creator of France's glorious age and the root of later crises. The model of absolute monarchy he established influenced political development throughout Europe. In popular culture, he is often depicted as the 'Sun King,' symbolizing absolute royal authority and splendor. His reign represented the pinnacle of the Ancien Régime and also foreshadowed its inevitable decline. Historians generally agree that his rule contained both pioneering achievements and serious limitations, making him a key figure in understanding France's transition from feudal society to the modern state.

others.zh: 他统治的时间如此之长，以至于人们开始认为君主制是永恒的。
others.en: He reigned so long that people began to think monarchy was eternal.
